description: The context ceiling, enforced at the one event where the number is true. The count comes from the transcript's newest assistant record, which describes the live context only at the moment a turn ends - a session reset in place keeps its transcript, so mid-turn that record can belong to a context that no longer exists. Stop refuses to let a session past the hard token maximum end its turn until it has run the message-in-a-bottle close-out. SessionStart on /clear drops the ceiling override the session set for itself, because the session that set it has ended even though its id has not. Every one of those hooks, and SessionStart on startup and resume, also writes the session's ceiling for memento's cc-candybar plugin, which they install. PreToolUse on Bash denies a backgrounded command that names finalize-session, because a close-out must run in the foreground as its turn's last call, and rewrites a foreground one so the words Claude Code's worktree guard refuses in a command (git, the shells) are spelled g-i-t, and a handoff is not refused for naming them. UserPromptSubmit journals a wake when the prompt is a memento handoff, naming the handoff file its last line gives, which is how a session's history is followed back to the session before it; any other prompt journals nothing, and no prompt is held back or changed.
